projects.title: Residence HVR
projects.name: HVR
projects.facts: Architecture Design Residential 6,081 SQ. FT. Completed
text: Nestling In Ahmedabad, Gujarat, HVR is a residence bungalow crafted in harmony with its user. Amidst Urban Surroundings, it is a peaceful corner plot in a gated residence society. The Initial Idea revolved around creating little barriers to allow daylight inside without losing the sense of warmth of a home. Drawing inspiration from the cultural richness of Gujarat, the design narrative is rooted in a cherished local saying, "ધરતી નો છેડો ઘર" meaning the earth ends at home, embodying a deep connection between humans and dwellings.

The doors and windows are made from reclaimed wood sourced from a demolished church in a nearby village. White walls and white marble, along with wood and plants make a more earthen Gandhian neutral palette. In this house, light plays with materials and creates a dynamic environment throughout the day, allowing users to occupy the house and make it into a home.

projects.title: School TPS
projects.name: TPS
projects.facts: Architecture Design School 14,970 SQ. FT. Ongoing
text: Within the Taxshila Vidhyapeeth campus, this school is thoughtfully designed to cater to the region’s hot and dry climate. Surrounded by trees, a hostel courtyard and existing structures the project seamlessly integrates with its context while embracing the needs of modern education.

Serving students from kindergarten to 7th standard, with additional spaces for postgraduate classes and campus administration, the design focuses on creating soft, playful, and interactive spaces. A large lobby connects the school to the adjacent old structure, fostering continuity between the past and present.

Courtyards and open spaces enhance natural light and ventilation, creating a climate-responsive and engaging environment for young learners. The staggered planning and clean, minimal forms reflect a modern aesthetic while responding thoughtfully to the site boundaries. Materials and techniques leverage local labor skills, ensuring the project remains rooted in its surroundings.

projects.title: Residence RJR
projects.name: RJR
projects.facts: Architecture Design Residential 10,100 SQ. FT. Ongoing
text: Project RJR is a meticulously crafted 10,100 sq ft luxury bungalow in Rajkot, designed to blend timeless elegance with contemporary functionality. The design emphasizes expansive spaces, thoughtful volumes, and seamless integration with nature, creating an environment of both grandeur and warmth.

Our approach celebrates clean aesthetics and material authenticity, ensuring that every detail speaks to a narrative of refined craftsmanship. The bungalow's architecture harmoniously balances openness and privacy, offering its inhabitants a lifestyle rooted in comfort and sophistication.

projects.title: Hospitality Restro-Club
projects.name: Restro-Club
projects.facts: Architecture Design Hospitality 6,120 SQ. FT. Proposal
text: The proposed design for the Sports Café in Rajkot, India, envisions a dynamic space that seamlessly blends the love for food with the excitement of sports. Designed to cater to the city's vibrant and growing interest in both outdoor and indoor sports, the café aims to become a lively destination for the youth and families alike. The architecture thoughtfully integrates a restaurant and sports café, fostering an environment where visitors can engage, relax, and socialize.

Overlooking a versatile lawn, the built structure provides a picturesque setting ideal for recreational activities or relaxed weekend brunches. The lawn doubles as a venue for informal games and community events, creating a seamless connection between leisure and sport. With its modern design, flexible spaces, and an energetic vibe, the project aspires to become a social and recreational hub that promotes a healthy and engaging lifestyle for Rajkot's community.

projects.title: Industrial Administration RMA
projects.name: RMA
projects.facts: Architecture Design Industrial 12,650 SQ. FT. Ongoing
text: The Administrative Headquarters, situated on an industrial plot in the outskirts of Rajkot, Gujarat, India, serves as the administrative nerve center for a cluster of industrial units within the same development. Nestled adjacent to a serene natural waterbody.

Designed to foster a harmonious blend of functionality and aesthetics, the building accommodates diverse functions across its floors, including a welcoming reception area and executive boardroom on the ground floor, dedicated administrative offices on the first floor, R&D department on the second floor, quality control operations on the third floor, and the Chairman's chambers along with a dedicated guest suite on the fourth floor.

Strategically located services and circulation elements maximize column-free workspaces within the building's core, while an elegant facade wrapped in chiseled marble and lush planters conceals service elements and allows for filtered natural light to permeate the interior spaces.
A refined material palette featuring natural materials like marble, exposed concrete, and Indian teak wood creates a timeless and sophisticated ambiance.

projects.title: Industrial Factory FFF
projects.name: Factory Fun Foods
projects.facts: Master Planning Architecture Design Industrial 21,000 SQ. FT. Ongoing
text: Factory Fun Foods: Masterplanning and Factory Design

At 540X, we had the opportunity to collaborate on the comprehensive masterplanning and design of the Factory Fun Foods facility. This project involves the creation of a highly functional and efficient factory layout that meets the specific needs of food production while ensuring seamless operations. Our design integrates a strategically organized site plan with essential areas such as administrative blocks, expansive shed areas, drying zones, and land development tailored to optimize workflow and productivity.

he design prioritizes both operational efficiency and the safety of the workforce, incorporating clear zoning for production, storage, and administrative functions. The drying area is strategically placed to maximize natural ventilation and energy efficiency, while the overall masterplan ensures smooth traffic flow between different sections of the facility. The combination of thoughtful architecture and site development ensures that Factory Fun Foods is positioned to scale effectively, supporting both current operations and future growth.

projects.title: Hospitality SSR
projects.name: SSR
projects.facts: Architecture Design Hospitality 5,275 SQ. FT. Ongoing
text: SSR – A Celebration of South Indian Splendor

SSR is a refined interpretation of traditional South Indian charm, crafted with big and luxurious architectural expressions. The grand interiors blend opulence with authenticity, offering an immersive dining environment that exudes elegance at every corner. From the soaring ceilings to intricate detailing inspired by South India's rich heritage, SSR creates an ambiance that redefines fine dining through a perfect harmony of culture and sophistication.

Designed for discerning guests, SSR elevates the dining experience with impeccable service and thoughtfully curated flavors from the diverse regions of South India. The culinary journey is complemented by a luxurious atmosphere where contemporary aesthetics meet traditional motifs, creating a sensory feast that delights the eyes, palate, and soul.

projects.title: Institute Science Centre
projects.name: Science Centre
projects.facts: Architecture Design Institute 45,650 SQ. FT. Unbuilt
text: Located amidst the vibrant landscape of Jalgaon, Maharashtra, the Science Centre is a beacon for curiosity-driven minds and a platform for engaging the community with the wonders of science and technology. The thoughtfully designed campus harmonizes modern architectural elements with natural landscapes, creating a space where learning, discovery, and cultural interaction come to life.

The centre houses a dynamic array of facilities, including a research centre, an exhibition and museum space, a fully equipped auditorium for conferences, and a futuristic planetarium. The architectural language emphasizes structural clarity and material authenticity, offering an immersive experience both indoors and outdoors. The amphitheatre, designed as a social gathering hub, invites people to connect, reflect, and share ideas under the open sky.

Interactive digital exhibits and installations engage visitors across all age groups, transforming abstract scientific concepts into tangible experiences. Sustainability and a connection with the surrounding environment play a central role in the design, making it not just a hub for scientific learning but also an architectural landmark that integrates seamlessly into its natural context.
The Science Centre in Jalgaon aspires to nurture innovation, spark creativity, and bridge the gap between science and society, making it a transformative space for generations to come.

projects.title: Residence KWV
projects.name: Weekend Home
projects.facts: Architecture Design Residential 3,050 SQ. FT. Unbuilt
text: KWV – A Weekend Retreat

Situated on a 500-var plot near Rajkot, KWV is a weekend home crafted for a family of three, with ample space to host guests. This farmhouse brings together the raw textures of concrete, stone, glass, and wood, creating spaces that feel grounded yet effortlessly elegant.
KWV offers three bedrooms, an activity room, a gym, and a glass outhouse, complemented by an organic-shaped swimming pool, a small tennis court, and versatile outdoor areas.
From a jacuzzi under a pitched roof to a shaded space with traditional jhulas and a tranquil viewing deck, every corner encourages relaxation and connection.

The design avoids excessive ornamentation, focusing instead on honest materials and functional simplicity. It’s a home that embraces the outdoors and lets the natural surroundings take the lead—a true retreat from the everyday.

projects.title: Residence Nirvana
projects.name: Nirvana
projects.facts: Interior Design Residential 1,100 SQ. FT. Completed
text: Nirvana Home is an ideal living space for our family—my wife, my retired parents, and myself. The design brief was simple: to create a light, airy, and minimalistic environment that is both functional and easy to maintain, while maximizing the enjoyment of the top-floor breeze in our new 14-story apartment.

This project is intended to enhance daily living and provide an inviting space for hosting gatherings. The design incorporates elegant elements such as brass pipe, steel’s bed, marble accents, and polished plywood, creating a harmonious blend of form and function. The plain white ceilings and walls serve as a backdrop, allowing the furniture, fabrics, and decor to take center stage.

projects.title: Residence SJA
projects.name: SJA
projects.facts: Interior Design Residential 940 SQ. FT. Completed
text: The three bedroom apartment was designed prioritizing functionality over excessive ornamentation. A minimalist approach was adopted to maximize the budget, focusing on intricate details that enhance usability. The material palette features warm steamed beech laminated wooden surfaces creating a cozy atmosphere, contrasted with earthy maroon limestone. Vibrant and luxurious upholstery adds richness to the space while maintaining simplicity.
The overall aesthetic embodies the elegant and minimalist Japandi style, seamlessly blended with elements of transitional design to achieve a balance of spaciousness and coziness.

projects.title: Residence HHA
projects.name: HHA
projects.facts: Interior Design Residential 1,800 SQ. FT. Completed
text: The four-bedroom apartment, HHR, was designed with a focus on creating a harmonious living experience that blends sophistication with functionality. A thoughtful design approach was taken to balance elegance and comfort, optimizing the spatial layout for daily living. Clean lines and a restrained material palette underscore a refined aesthetic, ensuring every element has a purpose.

Warm oak-textured finishes pair seamlessly with soft-toned flooring, creating an inviting ambience. Richly upholstered furnishings in muted jewel tones add depth and a touch of luxury to the interiors. The design philosophy draws inspiration from Indian minimalism, subtly infused with hints of traditional craftsmanship, resulting in a timeless and balanced living environment.

projects.title: Workspace MKG
projects.name: MKG
projects.facts: Interior Design Workspace 700 SQ. FT. Completed
text: Located in the rapidly developing area of Morbi, Gujarat, MKG Office is designed as a compact yet functional workspace for two young entrepreneurs. The office layout balances efficiency and privacy, incorporating a head office, staff workspace, finance office, and a welcoming reception area.

The design emphasizes light, airy spaces with a seamless hierarchy, where privacy is maintained through subtle transitions, such as fluted glass partitions, creating a sense of openness while preserving boundaries.

A modern material palette defines the interiors, featuring soft Kota green tiles, pristine white walls, and modest ceilings. Fluted laminates, wooden backdrops, and upholstery highlight the texture and warmth, while stone tabletops with edge molding ensure ergonomic comfort.
With its minimal approach, clean lines, and thoughtfully composed forms, MKG Office is a refined and functional space, tailored for contemporary workstyles.

projects.title: Retail YIP
projects.name: YIP
projects.facts: Interior Design Retail 475 SQ. FT. Proposal
text: YIP – A Whimsical Yogurt Experience

YIP is a vibrant and playful yogurt parlour designed to captivate guests with its cheerful ambiance and creative interiors. The space embraces bold colors, quirky patterns, and fluid design elements that evoke a sense of joy and lightheartedness. From imaginative seating arrangements to dynamic wall graphics, every detail invites guests to indulge not only in delicious yogurt creations but also in an immersive experience that sparks delight.

The design strikes a perfect balance between functionality and aesthetic charm, ensuring smooth customer flow and ample seating for a relaxed experience. Bright, energetic lighting complements the lively atmosphere, while thoughtful material choices ensure durability and comfort. YIP isn’t just a place to enjoy yogurt—it's a space where creativity meets flavor, making every visit unforgettable.

projects.title: Hospitality VAR
projects.name: VAR
projects.facts: Interior Design Hospitality 3,210 SQ. FT. Completed
text: Vadakkam Restaurant: A South Indian Culinary Haven Located in the heart of Rajkot, Vadakkam Restaurant is an immersive journey into the authentic flavours and vibrant culture of South India. The interior design celebrates the richness of the South through a thoughtful interplay of colours, textures, and light. The vibrant and inviting interior of this South Indian restaurant is designed to immerse guests in a unique experience. The bold yellow walls evoke warmth and energy, while the deep green ceiling, resembling banana leaves, brings a refreshing touch of nature indoors.

The frosted glass partitions subtly filter light, creating a play of shadows and adding privacy without isolation. Soft, earthy tones in the furnishings and table settings balance the vibrant colour palette, offering a sense of calm and comfort. The patterned floor tiles introduce a layer of cultural charm, complementing the understated elegance of the space. Overall, the design harmoniously blends modern aesthetics with elements inspired by South Indian traditions, creating an atmosphere that's both authentic and contemporary.

projects.title: Residence RKA
projects.name: RKA
projects.facts: Interior Design Residential 1,180 SQ. FT. Completed
text: Residence RKA – A Symphony of Marble and Wood

Residence RKA is a thoughtfully crafted 1180 sq ft home where refined details and a harmonious material palette create a distinctive living experience. The design celebrates the timeless beauty of marble, which lends a sense of sophistication to the interiors, while warm wooden elements add depth and comfort. Every corner has been meticulously detailed to enhance functionality while maintaining a seamless visual flow.

The residence strikes a perfect balance between elegance and warmth, offering an environment that feels both luxurious and inviting. Custom-crafted elements and tactile finishes further elevate the spatial experience, creating a home that resonates with the client’s desire for understated sophistication and thoughtful living.

projects.title: Residence NYA
projects.name: NYA
projects.facts: Interior Design Residential 910 SQ. FT. Completed
text: The NYA Baroda apartment is designed as a joyful sanctuary for a young couple and their child. This 2BHK home prioritizes functionality and simplicity, offering an open layout that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The TV unit, serving both the living and dining spaces, ensures the design flows effortlessly, while the strategically placed bench near the dining area invites residents to unwind and enjoy the picturesque lake view. Designed with a minimalist approach, the design embraces clean lines, lighter color tones, and modern materials.

Beige tiles, white walls, and simple ceilings create a serene backdrop. Light wood, green laminate, and muted blue upholstery accents add personality to the space. Open shelving in the kitchen provides a platform for daily essentials.
The NYA Baroda project exemplifies how thoughtful design can create a comfortable, stylish home on a modest budget, focusing on the essentials and celebrating the beauty of simplicity.

projects.title: Urban Greens
projects.name: Urban Greens
projects.facts: Brand Design Organic Farms Food & Beverage
text: Urban Greens – Branding & Packaging Design

Urban Greens was envisioned as a modern hydroponic farming brand, bringing fresh, healthy greens to urban dwellers. Our challenge was to craft an identity that reflected care, nourishment, and sustainability while seamlessly integrating with the fast-paced city life.

Inspired by Baymax from Big Hero 6, the logo embodies a nurturing presence—an organic yet futuristic symbol of health and responsibility. The color palette mirrors the essence of hydroponic farming, where green sprouts from blue .

Through meticulous research and iterative design, we developed a cohesive visual language that extended from branding to packaging. The Harvest Box packaging was designed for effortless weekly delivery, reinforcing the brand’s promise of freshness and convenience.
Designed at 540X, the project refined our understanding of proportion, grids, and visual storytelling—transforming failures into learnings and ideas into impactful design.

projects.title: Studio Revah
projects.name: Studio Revah
projects.facts: Brand Design Design Studio AEC Sector
text: Revah - Branding & Identity Design

The logo and visual language we developed for Studio Revah represent a journey, one that echoes the rhythm of life and constant evolution. We worked closely with the team to ensure that their brand identity would stand out in the design world—while remaining grounded in authenticity and meaningful connection. Our collaboration with Studio Revah reflects our commitment to designing brands that not only look striking but also communicate their deeper essence effectively.

A design studio inspired by the fluidity and continuity of the Narmada River. Our approach was to create a visual identity that embodied the essence of movement, harmony, and timelessness. Through strategic design, we reflected the studio’s philosophy of fluidity, ensuring that every element of the brand resonated with its core values of creativity and purposeful design.

projects.title: Sofamous Furnitures
projects.name: Sofamous Furnitures
projects.facts: Brand Refresh Sofa & Furnitures Manufacturing Sector
text: Sofamous – Rebranding & Visual Design

A name that always held its essence, now seen in a new light. The rebranding of Sofamous unveils a design that is both simple and striking—placing the product boldly within its identity, hidden in plain sight until now.

By refining the visual language, we highlight what was always there, making the brand unmistakable and unforgettable. A seamless fusion of clarity and impact, this transformation ensures Sofamous stands out with confidence and recognition.

projects.title: House of Noor
projects.name: House of Noor
projects.facts: Brand Design Apparels & Clothing
text: Brand Design - Clothing & Apparels

House of Noor is a label born from a shared love for fabric, craft, and culture. Rooted in India’s rich heritage of textile artistry, the brand pays homage to skilled artisans who preserve and refine these timeless traditions. The identity reflects this ethos—blending elegance with authenticity to create a visual language that feels both modern and deeply connected to its origins.

Our branding approach captures the essence of Noor—light, grace, and craftsmanship—through refined typography, a warm, sophisticated color palette, and symbolic elements that echo the delicate intricacies of handwoven textiles. House of Noor stands as a bridge between heritage and contemporary fashion, celebrating the soul of tradition in every detail.

projects.title: Seaform Visuals
projects.name: Seaform Visualisation
projects.facts: Brand Design 3d visualisation AEC Sector
text: Studio Seaform – Visual Identity

The Studio Seaform logo and brand vision reflect the interplay between movement and form—capturing the transient beauty of waves as they take shape upon the shore. The bold yet fluid typography in "SF" mirrors the rhythm of the sea, embodying the essence of ideas taking form through visualization.

Studio Seaform embodies the fluidity of thought and the ever-changing nature of creativity. Inspired by the sea—its rhythm, its depth, and the fleeting forms it takes upon the shore—the visual identity captures moments of stillness within constant motion. It is a reflection of how ideas evolve, transform, and leave an imprint, much like waves shaping the coastline.

projects.title: Sweat Now
projects.name: SweatNow.
projects.facts: Brand Refresh Fitness Gym Health & Fitness
text: SweatNow Fitness – Branding & Visual Identity

Power, momentum, and relentless energy—SweatNow. Fitness embodies the drive to push limits and ignite transformation. The brand identity fuses boldness with dynamism, symbolized by a striking lightning bolt that represents strength, speed, and electrifying motivation.

From the raw simplicity of the logo and the disciplined usage of assets, SweatNow Fitness is more than a brand, It’s a call to action. Our branding approach channels this ethos into a sleek, high-contrast visual language that resonates with athletes and fitness enthusiasts alike.

projects.title: Poshan
projects.name: Poshan
projects.facts: Brand Design Nutritionist Health & Wellness
text: Poshan – Custom Typeface & Branding (2022)

Poshan, a brand rooted in regional food-based nutrition, required an identity that felt authentic, grounded, and culturally resonant. When the founder approached us, they had minimal expectations—but we saw an opportunity to craft something truly unique.
Rather than relying on existing typefaces, we built the typography from scratch, drawing inspiration from regional scripts to reflect the essence of indigenous diets.

This approach ensured that the visual identity felt as natural and distinct as the food philosophy it represented. The result was a bespoke typeface that seamlessly blended tradition with modernity, giving Poshan a voice that was both familiar and fresh.
